newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - April 2.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - April 2.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Wednesday:
* On Tuesday, the Dow Jones industrial average rose 27.57 points to 6,611.05 as the interest rate outlook remained far from clear, leaving market matters looking anything but certain.
* Indonesia's customs administration resumed its inspection authority on Tuesday, marking the start of the formal implementation of the 1995 customs law.
* On Tuesday, the Jakarta composite index tumbled 10.23 points, or 1.54 percent, to close at 652.01 points.
* On Wednesday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,398.25/99.00 at 0130 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,398.25/99.00.
* Trading firm Aneka Kimia and starch-based sorbitol manufacturer Sorini on renewed market talk of a possible merger.
* Bank Lippo after announcement of a rise in its 1996 net profit.
* Forestry firms Barito and Sumalindo after news reports on the government's decision to raise forestry fees for cutting rounded woods.
* Garment firm Great River on a newspaper report it expected to book a net profit growth of 65 percent in 1997.
